method.method_draft: First read the boxplots: the horizontal axis is sodium content in mg, with tick marks from about 75 to 300. For Regular Chips, estimate the left edge of the box at about 145 mg and the right edge at about 210 mg, so IQR ≈ 210 − 145 = 65 mg. For Healthy Chips, estimate the left edge of the box at about 120 mg and the right edge at about 220 mg, so IQR ≈ 220 − 120 = 100 mg. Since about 100 mg is greater than about 65 mg, conclude that the IQR for healthy chips is greater than the IQR for regular chips.
